WITH status_shares AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
), above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count, share
  FROM status_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the shares for each distinct powerstatus group, counting NULL as one group.
